summary: ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES ** L1 resources are automatically generated from public CloudFormation Resource Schemas. They are built to closely reflect the real state of CloudFormation. Sometimes these updates can contain changes that are incompatible with previous types, but more accurately reflect reality. In this release we have changed: aws-codebuild: AWS::CodeBuild::Project: Id attribute removed. aws-dax: AWS::DAX::Cluster: Id attribute removed. aws-ec2: AWS::EC2::ClientVpnTargetNetworkAssociation: Id attribute removed.
